name: Temporary clean EOSE EXEC-0010 bootstrap

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - bootstrap/eose-exec-0010-clean

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  bootstrap:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Check out exact canonical main
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Configure commit identity
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Create clean governed execution session
        env:
          EOS_ACTOR: chatgpt
        run: |
          BASELINE="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          test "$BASELINE" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)"
          ./scripts/eos execute WP-MVP-0005 --base origin/main --actor chatgpt --json | tee /tmp/eose-exec-0010.json
          test -f .eos/executions/EXEC-0010.json
          grep -q $'EXEC-0010\t.eos/executions/EXEC-0010.json\tWP-MVP-0005\tRUNNING\twp/mvp-0005\t' .eos/executions.tsv
          python3 - "$BASELINE" <<'PY'
          import json, sys
          from pathlib import Path
          expected = sys.argv[1]
          session = json.loads(Path('.eos/executions/EXEC-0010.json').read_text())
          assert session['registry']['baseline_commit'] == expected, (session['registry']['baseline_commit'], expected)
          assert session['environment']['head'] == expected, (session['environment']['head'], expected)
          assert session['registry']['status'] == 'RUNNING'
          assert session['registry']['branch'] == 'wp/mvp-0005'
          PY

      - name: Publish governed implementation baseline
        run: git push origin wp/mvp-0005:wp/mvp-0005

      - name: Refresh deterministic projections
        run: |
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write

      - name: Validate clean execution state
        run: |
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          python3 scripts/generate-mvp-work-packets.py --check
          python3 scripts/populate-artifact-system.py --check
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict

      - name: Commit and publish clean control state
        run: |
          git add -A
          git commit -m "chore(eose): record clean EXEC-0010 execution session"
          git push origin HEAD:eose/exec-0010-start-clean
